blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — Five days after she was critically wounded in the Banga National High School shooting in South Cotabato, a Grade 9 female student who suffered a gunshot wound in the head is showing signs of recovery. This development comes after the victim underwent surgery at the Cotabato Regional and Medical Center in Cotabato City. Rolly Doane Aquino, South Cotabato Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO) chief, said Tuesday the victim was already conscious and responsive. He also said the student can breathe on her own after doctors removed her mechanical ventilator and intubation tube. Aquino reported that […]...
